target: Automatically induce a content-bound exact Boolean Schaefer basis from raw explicit relation semantics with no trusted carrier/class labels, then admit or fail closed before solver execution.

object.constraints: array of objects containing only id, scope, allowed
object.allowed: explicit list of allowed 0/1 tuples of length equal to scope arity

raw_input_contract.semantic_authority: The explicit allowed tuples are the complete relation semantics for this scoped gate.

frozen_basis_language.ZERO_VALID: every raw relation contains its all-zero tuple
frozen_basis_language.ONE_VALID: every raw relation contains its all-one tuple
frozen_basis_language.HORN: every raw relation is closed under coordinatewise AND
frozen_basis_language.DUAL_HORN: every raw relation is closed under coordinatewise OR
frozen_basis_language.BIJUNCTIVE: every raw relation is closed under coordinatewise majority
frozen_basis_language.AFFINE: every raw relation is closed under coordinatewise minority/xor3

proof_obligations.P1_source_binding: Hash the canonical raw object before discovery. The certificate must bind exactly to that hash and canonical relation surface.
proof_obligations.P2_label_blindness: No carrier/class/kind field may influence discovery; forbidden trusted fields must be rejected if supplied.
proof_obligations.P3_exact_algebraic_induction: Compute all six basis predicates from raw allowed tuples only using the frozen Schaefer closure operations already present in the sealed mixed-carrier barrier implementation.
proof_obligations.P4_abstraction_adequacy: A selected basis is admissible only if its exact closure predicate holds for every distinct raw relation in the bound object; the complete per-relation and language-level fingerprint must be emitted for independent replay.
proof_obligations.P5_fail_closed_before_execution: If no basis class is common to the complete language, return OPEN_NO_SCHAEFER_BASIS with solver_invocations=0 and carrier_executions=0.
proof_obligations.P6_invariance: Renaming relation IDs, permuting constraint order, and permuting tuple order must not change the induced language fingerprint or selected basis.
proof_obligations.P7_polynomial_discovery_accounting: For explicit relation R with s_R allowed tuples and arity a_R, binary closure work is O(s_R^2 a_R) and ternary closure work is O(s_R^3 a_R); total discovery/certificate/replay must be polynomial in explicit raw input bytes. No variable-assignment cube may be enumerated.
proof_obligations.P8_claim_ceiling: A PASS proves only scoped automatic induction/admission of the six frozen Schaefer bases from explicit raw relation tables. It does not discover arbitrary new carriers, solve unrestricted mixed languages, prove SAT in P, or advance P vs NP.

frozen_controls.C4_surface_permutation: Permute relation IDs, constraint order and allowed tuple order; fingerprint and selected basis must be invariant.
frozen_controls.C5_tampered_certificate: Independent checker must reject a certificate claiming a basis whose closure predicate fails on the raw tuples.
frozen_controls.C6_forbidden_label_injection: A raw object containing kind/carrier/class metadata must be rejected rather than trusted.
